name: Completed lifecycle stages remain view-only in the same application
description:
Objective: Completed lifecycle stages remain view-only in the same application.
Preconditions: Open Merchant call workflow with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Merchant call workflow.
2. Completed lifecycle stages remain view-only in the same application.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The same data and state remain available after the reload or subsequent lookup.
